summary: Write up the failure-code comparison and the go/no-go recommendation
description:
Turn the review data into a decision document under docs/dossiers/.

Report the failure-code DISTRIBUTION, not the accept rate alone — the question is which failures you would rather review, not which model scores higher. Test the stated hypothesis explicitly: GROUND/LEAK down, COVERAGE/FORMAT up. State plainly if it did not hold.

Report the logia subset separately from the Iamblichus-heavy set; if local degrades sharply on sayings order, that is the finding regardless of the aggregate.

Be explicit about what was NOT tested: the fold/map-reduce path (never-run code) and every structured field. A pass here licenses a Phase 2, not a provider switch.

DONE: committed doc with the contingency table, the hypothesis verdict, a recommendation, and — if the answer is yes — the concrete next campaign config. Owner keeps the call.
